Name: (AT)(CP) Pixie's MCM Rugs
Author: caterpixies
Description:
[center][/center][center][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][b][b][font=Georgia][b][b][b][b]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/b][/b][/b][/font][/b][/b][/font]


[size=3]This is a collection of 41 rugs in the mid-century modern style! [/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]They are all meant to fit together in a cohesive color palette, and I [b]highly[/b] recommend using them along with Precise Furniture to get the best use out of them.
[/size]
[/font]

[font=Georgia][size=4][b]How to Use:[/b][/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=3][u]Content Patcher ver.[/u][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36735]the catalogue[/url]﻿, Calcifer and Content Patcher
2. [b]In game[/b]: purchase the catalogue from [b]Robin's Shop

[/b][font=Georgia][size=3][u]Alternative Textures ver.[/u][/size][/font]
[/size][size=3]1. Download Alternative Textures
2. [b]In game: [/b]Purchase the [b]paint bucket[/b] from Robin's shop
3. Use the paint bucket on the correct rugs to change the textures.

[/size][/font][size=3][font=Georgia]I'm too lazy to add a reference pics now but here's the vanilla rugs used:
2x1: Bamboo Mat
2x2: Woodcut Rug
3x2: Red Cottage Rug
4x3: Large Cottage Rug
**NEW** 5x4: Blossom Rug[/font]
[/size]

[font=Georgia][size=4][b]FAQ:[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b]

[u][/u][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b][u][/u][/b][font=Georgia][size=3][size=3][b][u] When is the rest of the collection coming out?[/u][/b]
Honestly, I’m working full-time and going to school, so this is kind of just a hobby for me. I'm also really anal about how I want everything to look, so it takes me a bit of time. But I’m definitely working on it and I’ll release stuff as it’s ready!

[b][u]Q: What’s next on the roadmap?[/u][/b]
[/size]I'm wanting to make this collection as modular as possible, so with that in mind I want to make a separate painting.decoration/clutter pack which might be next! Or I also want to work on living room stuff, so whichever inspires me more tbh.[/size][/font][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3][b]

You can also message me on Discord (it's probably the fastest way to get to me): caterpixie[/font][b]
